Treatment summary
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck from the side while the patient
was turning left. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the type and force of the impact, and the resulting right knee
complaints are medically plausible given that mechanism. Over the course of care, the patient completed 27 visits, which is
somewhat longer than typically expected for this type of knee injury, and progress was gradual. Examination revealed some
findings that support a soft tissue injury to the knee, including localized tenderness and reduced range of motion, while other
orthopedic tests and neurovascular assessemnts were within normal limits. The patient reports a prior minor strain in the same
region several yeras ago, which resolved completely without ongoing limitation. Review of the billing records shows that
services were billed once as documented and without duplicate charges. Ongoing monitoring and home exercise instruction were
provided, and the patient was advised to continue a graduated strengthening program.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
